definition: A steroid hormone produced by the adrenal glands that helps regulate stress response, blood sugar, and metabolism in the body.
translation: 皮質醇（一種由腎上腺分泌的類固醇激素，幫助調節壓力反應、血糖和新陳代謝）
example: When you experience prolonged stress, your body releases cortisol, which can affect your sleep and immune system.
